edge_explainer.market_believes: A permanently stuck 'accessible luxury' brand on its 4th strategy pivot in a decade, guilty by association with a collapsing sector tape (Kering -14%, China fragile) — the +5% comp exit is easy-base arithmetic, margins are just cost cuts.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The margin tells a different story: gross margin +530bps to 67.9% on only +2% comps is a FULL-PRICE, mix-quality recovery — promo-driven comps cannot produce that. Comps accelerated every single quarter (-1→+2→+3→+5), debt is down to 1.6x, and management held the dividend suspended rather than manufacture a recovery signal.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Corrected after a skeptic pass: 'sector guilt' doesn't survive its own data — LVMH is flat-to-up while Kering collapses, so the market IS discriminating within luxury, and Burberry's price plausibly reflects Burberry facts (EMEIA weak, easy comps). Our claim is narrower: a probability disagreement about the up-tail — we weight the +530bps FULL-PRICE gross-margin recovery (a mix-quality fact promo comps cannot produce) more than the market does. We assign ~72% to the up-path vs the ~62% implied by our scenario tree at this price.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: Base fair value ≈ the current price — the market fairly prices the central turnaround; ALL of our edge lives in the up-tail (full normalization to mid-teens margins). The biggest region (EMEIA) is still flat-to-negative, part of the margin gain laps a one-off markdown reset, and the hard comparisons arrive in H2 — after both catalysts. Hence 5/10 and 1% only.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Jul-17 Q1 trading update (verified twice against the company's own calendar): do comps hold >=+3-4% and EMEIA >=-3%? Then the ~Nov H1 for margins.
edge_explainer.edge_type: a differing prior on the up-tail, grounded in one verified margin-quality datum; no behavioral mechanism claimed
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: If Jul-17 comps hold but the stock doesn't re-rate, the market was weighting EMEIA/China correctly and the margin datum was already in the price — the disagreement resolves against us without the thesis 'failing'.
